messages.content: Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. Copy the span of words that lies between (and including) index 5 and 15, the indices are word indices, split by whitespace!

message.content:
FADE IN:

EXT. LAKESIDE - DAY

A golden light bathes the still water of a forgotten lake. The sky above is a canvas of pale amber, the sun beginning its slow retreat behind a veil of clouds.

A FISH — a slender, silver creature with eyes like polished glass — darts through the surface, trailing a ribbon of bubbles behind it.

A HAND emerges from the reeds. A weathered palm, fingers curled with intention. The hand closes around the fish mid-swim.

The fish is lifted from the water. Its scales glisten with droplets that catch the light. Its mouth opens and closes, a silent gasp against the unfamiliar air.

A HUMAN — face unseen, only the hand and forearm visible — holds the fish up. The fish writhes gently, its tail flicking in desperate arcs.

The human tilts the fish upward, aligning its wide, unblinking eyes with the sky.

The sun begins to dim. A shadow creeps across the face of it, slow and deliberate. The world dims. The fish's reflection in its own eye darkens.

The eclipse swallows the sun whole.

The fish stares into the black circle on the white sky, its gills pumping, its body trembling with a rhythm that is almost — almost — a prayer.

HOLD.

FADE TO BLACK.

---

DAY A golden light bathes the still water of a forgotten
